newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello expects Australia banks to cut rates.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello expects Australia banks to cut rates.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday he expected all of Australia's major banks to cut variable home loan interest rates to 8.75 percent.
"Already some of the banks have cut their standard variable and I expect all of the majors will correspondingly reduce their standard variable rates to 8.75 percent," Costello told reporters.
Earlier Commonwealth Bank of Australia and Australia and New Zealand Banking Group Ltd said they would cut variable home loan rates to 8.75 percent in the next month or two.
The Reserve Bank earlier eased monetary policy, dropping its overnight cash rate target to 6.5 percent from 7.0 percent.
